comment: Exact record of github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6 behaviour on the OPTIONAL format-assertion cases of the official JSON-Schema-Test-Suite (draft2020-12). Draft 2020-12 makes "format" an annotation unless a validator opts in; the conformance gate deliberately does NOT opt in, so none of the divergences listed here weaken it. They are pinned so that a regression, an improvement, or a suite refresh all show up as a test failure instead of passing unnoticed. Regenerate by re-running TestOptionalFormatAssertionSupport and transcribing the reported difference. At the recorded suite revision: 762 cases executed, 119 unsupported.
